name: io.github.soluai-spa/solucortex-mcp
description: Living technical memory for AI agents: recall approved project context, record what was learned.

environmentVariables.name: SOLUCORTEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SoluCortex project API key (scx_...). Get one at https://solucortex.ai.

environmentVariables.name: SOLUCORTEX_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default project UUID. Optional: the backend infers it from the API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your SoluCortex project API key (scx_...)>. Get one at https://solucortex.ai.

headers.name: X-Solucortex-Project
headers.description: Default project UUID. Optional: the backend infers it from the API key.
